description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], and [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)], grants [Buff Fire 10% (15s)], [Buff Ice 10% (15s)] and [Buff Lightning 10% (15s)] to all allies, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cater], [Apex Elementillery Damage Tracker] and [Apex Elementillery Level]

description.name: Buff Fire 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Fire damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Ice 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Lightning 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cater
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Elementillery (0~2), removed after using Apex Elementillery two times

description.name: Apex Elementillery Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Elementillery level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cater]

description.name: Apex Elementillery Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Elementillery level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cater]
